method.value: MADEX LVG models with temperature/density sub-components

findings_qualitative.value: Hot core Trot distribution is much wider than other components, indicating most complex thermal structure

evidence.quote: the spread in rotation temperature is much larger toward the hot core relative to the other spatial/velocity components

claims.hypothesis: Are LTE models adequate for complex organics?
claims.experiment: Reduced chi-square of XCLASS fits across HIFI band
claims.result: 47 of 80 models have chi2_red<=1.5; complex organics mostly low
claims.finding: LTE good for complex organics, implying n>1e6 cm-3

evidence.loc: 4.1 The Full Band Model and Line Statistics
evidence.quote: over half, 47 out of 80, of the XCLASS models have $\chi_{\rm red}^{2}$ $\le$ 1.5

claims.hypothesis: Do LTE abundances agree with non-LTE?

evidence.quote: Abundances derived from our XCLASS and more advanced MADEX models typically agree to within a factor of 3

claims.hypothesis: Is OCS/CS high Trot in compact ridge spatially distinct?
claims.experiment: ALMA SV integrated maps vs methyl formate
claims.result: OCS and CS peaks offset from MF1 and MF3 nearer LVF

evidence.quote: both the OCS and CS peaks are offset from MF1 and MF3, occurring midway between the two and closer to the edge of the CH$_{3}$OCHO cavity
